mapper.update:
MERGE INTO REP_TRADE_INFO RPI USING (
SELECT '${item.id}' ID, '${item.assetId}' ASSET_ID, '${item.assetName}' ASSET_NAME, '${item.tradeCounty}' TRADE_COUNTY, #{item.tradeDate,jdbcType=DATE}null TRADE_DATE, ${item.tradeAmt}null TRADE_AMT, '${item.tradeType}' TRADE_TYPE, '${item.buyPart}' BUY_PART, '${item.salePart}' SALE_PART, '${item.ps}' PS, '${item.status}' STATUS, '${item.isRelationTrade}' IS_RELATION_TRADE, '${item.createUser}' CREATE_USER, '${item.createDept}' CREATE_DEPT, #{item.createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}null CREATE_TIME, '${item.updateUser}' UPDATE_USER, #{item.updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}null UPDATE_TIME, ${item.expireRate}null EXPIRE_RATE, '${item.contractNo}' CONTRACT_NO, '${item.prodId}' PROD_ID, ${item.prinAmt}null PRIN_AMT FROM sysibm.SYSDUMMY1
) TEMP
ON( RPI.ID = TEMP.ID )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
RPI.ASSET_ID = TEMP.ASSET_ID, RPI.ASSET_NAME = TEMP.ASSET_NAME, RPI.TRADE_COUNTY = TEMP.TRADE_COUNTY, RPI.TRADE_DATE = TEMP.TRADE_DATE, RPI.TRADE_AMT = TEMP.TRADE_AMT, RPI.TRADE_TYPE = TEMP.TRADE_TYPE, RPI.BUY_PART = TEMP.BUY_PART, RPI.SALE_PART = TEMP.SALE_PART, RPI.PS = TEMP.PS, RPI.STATUS = TEMP.STATUS, RPI.IS_RELATION_TRADE = TEMP.IS_RELATION_TRADE, RPI.CREATE_USER = TEMP.CREATE_USER, RPI.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, RPI.CREATE_TIME = TEMP.CREATE_TIME, RPI.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, RPI.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, RPI.EXPIRE_RATE = TEMP.EXPIRE_RATE, RPI.CONTRACT_NO = TEMP.CONTRACT_NO, RPI.PROD_ID = TEMP.PROD_ID, RPI.PRIN_AMT = TEMP.PRIN_AMT
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( ID, ASSET_ID, ASSET_NAME, TRADE_COUNTY, TRADE_DATE, TRADE_AMT, TRADE_TYPE, BUY_PART, SALE_PART, PS, STATUS, IS_RELATION_TRADE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, EXPIRE_RATE, CONTRACT_NO, PROD_ID, PRIN_AMT ) VALUES ( TEMP.ID, TEMP.ASSET_ID, TEMP.ASSET_NAME, TEMP.TRADE_COUNTY, TEMP.TRADE_DATE, TEMP.TRADE_AMT, TEMP.TRADE_TYPE, TEMP.BUY_PART, TEMP.SALE_PART, TEMP.PS, TEMP.STATUS, TEMP.IS_RELATION_TRADE, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, TEMP.EXPIRE_RATE, TEMP.CONTRACT_NO, TEMP.PROD_ID, TEMP.PRIN_AMT )
